summary: A 1941 U.S. Forest Service lookout on the Malheur National Forest in Grant County, Oregon, staffed each summer; sources disagree on its height.

facts.design: USFS wooden tower with L-4 hip-roof cab

access.note: Public parking at the lookouts; visitors welcome during daylight hours. Staffed in summer; the forest asks visitors to respect staff after hours and during high fire activity.

visit.trail_note: Drive up the spur road from the signed junction of NF-1516 and NF-3925; a gate sits at the spur.

events.note: Register and firelookout.com both give 1941; they disagree on height (60 ft per register, 50 ft per firelookout.com).
Merrill McKearn is listed as known lookout personnel for 1941.
Registered March 8, 1995; nominated by Ron Johnson, Oregon Registrar.
Threatened by a forest fire; no damage reported in these sources.
Listed among staffed lookouts on the Blue Mountain Ranger District, staffed through the summer months.

notes_for_editor: Height is disputed: the register says a 60-ft CT-2 tower, firelookout.com says 50 ft. No height_m is set and the record has none. The 1941 date agrees across both lookout pages. Staffing comes from a 2023 local news report and a May 2022 register visit, so current status is unconfirmed. History searches turned up nothing beyond these pages. No photos gathered. Visit details are from a single visitor report.
